items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: All the way up my band, the original Untouchables, Larry Marino, Charlie Burbank, and Dalton Russo, Buddy Williams, all these people could play.

ctx.x: 86. So we were talking about dramas.

Yeah, well I was talking about the present drummer that I have in my present band today, and I stated just a minute ago that I have been associated with better musicians in all of my days, and I'm talking about from way back with doing the Earl Palmer era with David Tholomew, Ernest MacLange, Salvador Doucette, see these people are musicians, there ain't no F and A's about it. Okay, that's a caliber musician I have dealt with. All the way up my band, the original Untouchables, Larry Marino, Charlie Burbank, and…

items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: me, Emma Rett, Marino with Harriet, and Moran with Gloria Bell. So we, the three of us were buddies, and we would always go out together on Sundays.

ctx.x: So you don't remember dating before you went into service? No. I mean going out with your

own place? No, no. No, not at all. You see, you know, back then it's altogether different from what it is now. You know, like, you talking about virgin boys? Virgin? Yeah. Strictly. So who was the first girl that you met? Well, what I can remember, the first girl I met, Mabel was Emma Rett. When I came out of the service, that was the first girl I met. And she wanted to be my girlfriend. And we did, we'd go out, me, Emma Rett, Marino with Harriet, and Moran with Gloria Bell. So we, the three of us were buddies,…
So, let, let, we can, um, so the girl you, the girl you went out with on this one time?
